transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I just... haven't been doing much lately. I've stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. 

...Haven't been to church gatherings, or salsa nights. I stopped cooking for the neighbors. I don't even really want to walk into my shop anymore... I'm a carpenter, and usually I like just going in there to enjoy the smell of the wood, but... I just haven't wanted to. 

That's why I'm here, I suppose.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

I suppose so, yeah. ...Mostly in the mornings. I just wake up with this... heavy feeling in my chest. Just empty. It's like all the color's gone out of the house, I guess. I try to keep it to myself. I have to force myself not to... well, not to break down in front of my wife.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been... a while. Maybe six months? It's been dragging on. At first I thought maybe it was just a bad week, or... just regular stress, you know? But it hasn't gone away. It's just stayed like this.
Do you still enjoy things when you do them, even if you don't feel like doing them?

Not really, no. Like I said before... I just don't have any interest in those things anymore. The salsa nights, the church stuff... even just being in the shop. It's not the same. I just don't get anything out of it now.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I don't know... I haven't really been checking. My clothes still fit about the same, I guess. So... probably not.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and fidgety?

I guess... the guys at work have said something about it. They reckon I move like my boots are full of wet cement sometimes. Just takes me forever to pick up a board. Or... I don't know. Sometimes I just end up pacing around the shop. Rubbing my hands. Not really doing anything useful.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah... I suppose. Just... stuff with my wife. Her health. 

I just keep replaying it all in my head. Every appointment she had, every little thing that changed. Just... thinking I should have caught it sooner. If I was a better husband, I would've... I don't know. Protected her from it somehow.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?

I... don't really want to talk about that. 

But, I mean... sometimes I just think... maybe it'd be easier if I just... didn't wake up. You know? Just... go to sleep and that's it. And sometimes... I don't know, I catch myself thinking maybe the kids... maybe they'd be better off if I wasn't around dragging everyone down. 

It... it scares me a bit when I think like that. But... yeah.
Have you had these thoughts of not wanting to wake up or being better off not being around more than half of the days in the past two weeks?

I don't know. I haven't really been keeping track. 

The days just sort of... blur together lately. So... I couldn't tell you if it's been that many.
Have you had little interest or pleasure in doing things more than half of the days in the past two weeks?

Yeah. Probably most days. I just... I've stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. 

I haven't been going to church gatherings, or... salsa nights. I used to cook for the neighbors, but I stopped that too. I don't even want to walk into my shop anymore. Usually I like just... being in there, the smell of the wood. But... I don't know. I just don't care to do any of it right now.
Have you experienced a significant loss of energy or fatigue most days in the past two weeks?

Yeah. I guess so. 

I just... I'm always tired. Even if I sleep all night, or just sit around... my body just feels heavy. Worn out. Like I've been framing a roof all day, but I haven't done anything. 

Even just... I don't know, loading a few tools into the truck. It just feels like too much work. So I just... don't do it.
Have you been feeling restless and fidgety most days in the past two weeks?

I guess... maybe. The guys at the site have made a few comments lately. 

They say I either move like my boots are full of wet cement... taking forever just to pick up a single board... or I just end up pacing around the shop. Just... rubbing my hands together. Not actually doing anything useful. So... yeah. I suppose so.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual most days in the past two weeks?
Yeah, I think I just mentioned that. The guys said I'm moving like my boots are full of wet cement. It takes me forever just to pick up a board. Or I'm just pacing. So, yeah. I guess I'm moving slow.
Have you had nearly every day feeling sad or empty for the past two weeks?

Yeah... I suppose. 

It's just... most mornings, I wake up and there's this... this heavy, empty feeling right here in my chest. It's like... I don't know, like all the color's just gone out of the house. 

I just try to keep it together. I have to force myself not to just... break down, you know? Especially in front of my wife. I don't want her to see it. But... yeah. It's been there.
Have you been feeling worthless most days in the past two weeks?

I don't... I don't know if worthless is the right word. But... 

I just... I keep replaying things. Every appointment she had, every little change in her health... I just keep thinking that a better husband would have caught it sooner. That I should have protected her somehow. It's just... hard not to feel like I failed her.
Have you been feeling like you're moving more slowly than usual or feeling restless and fidgety most days recently?
Didn't we... didn't I just answer that? Like I said a minute ago, I'm just moving slow. Or pacing around. I don't really have anything else to add to it.
Have you had at least five of these symptoms nearly every day for the past two weeks?
I don't... I haven't been keeping count of them. I just... I know I've been feeling the way I told you. Every day. That's all I know.
Have you had a decrease in interest or pleasure in most activities for most of every day for the past two weeks?

Yeah, I suppose so. I just... I haven't been doing much of anything. The things I usually like to do... I just don't have the drive for them right now. 

I haven't been going to salsa nights or church gatherings. I haven't even been cooking for the neighbors like I usually do. Even just... going out to my shop. I used to like just walking in there, smelling the wood. But I haven't even wanted to do that lately.
Would you say your depression is mild, moderate, or severe?
I don't... I wouldn't really know how to rate it. It's just heavy. I couldn't tell you what label fits it.
